title: Pokémon Horizons
description: Liko and Hattrem, Bonded by Happiness! Liko worries that Hattrem could be holding itself back for the sake of others.

title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back
description: Darkness spreads all over Alfea as Flora's parents arrive to help the Winx.

title: The Next Step: Cheer
description: Cammy accidentally starts a rumour. Damian challenges Layla. Melody tries to catch a cold.

title: Newsround
description: Topical news magazine for children.

title: Blue Peter: Children in Need SPOTacular
description: Shini and Abby go head-to-head in an epic Children in Need racing challenge, and Tyler West and Hacker make some delicious Pudsey Pizzas.

title: Deadly 60
description: Steve seeks out deadly creatures in miniature, including Australia's most beautiful spider, Oman's deadly deathstalker scorpion and a bright blue beauty in Indonesia.

title: Around the World in 80 Gardens
description: Monty Don visits the world's 80 most inspiring gardens, this time in south east Asia, on a quest for the real tropical garden.

title: Naturewatch
description: Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin explore why geese fly in a V formation, why leaves change colour in autumn and why birds eat rocks.

title: My Life at Christmas: Anita Rani Meets Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster
description: Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster talk fame, faith and festive memories with Anita Rani.

title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
description: With a range of weekend breakfasts from granola cupcakes to an incredible breakfast pizza.

description: Libya, 1942. Captain Anson is cut off from his unit and must return to Alexandria.

description: Martin wants to run for the hills because of a tricky legal issue in Devon. Jacqui is in Eastbourne, where work is already under way at an end-of-terrace.

title: Flog It!
description: Paul Martin and his team of experts invite members of the public to bring their antiques to be viewed and valued, with an option to sell at auction.

title: Match of the Day Wales: Norway v Wales
description: Live coverage as Wales take on Norway in Oslo for their penultimate game in the Nations League.

title: International Football: Northern Ireland v Ukraine
description: Live coverage as Northern Ireland host Ukraine in the Nations League with promotion to League A in sight.

title: 40 Hits of 1975 at the BBC
description: Take a musical trip back in time with 40 essential hits from the year 1975, plucked from the BBC's archives.

description: In the late 19th century, a young Danish priest is sent to a remote part of Iceland. Deals with adult themes.

description: A tragedy reveals dangerous secrets, and Michael is forced to make a confession. Contains strong language.

title: Celebrity Race Across the World
description: The second leg of the race takes the teams across the heart of Borneo to a modern metropolis on its eastern coast and their second checkpoint.

title: This is BBC Two
description: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

title: My Life at Christmas: Anita Rani Meets Ade Adepitan
description: Anita Rani meets Ade Adepitan to explore his journey to Paralympic glory.

title: Countryfile
description: Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across County Antrim are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future.

title: Landward
description: Dougie visits a Glasgow nature reserve that has transformed into a thriving, green place.

title: Sian Eleri's BBC Children in Need Road Trip
description: Radio 1's Sian Eleri takes to the road visiting BBC Children in Need projects in Wales.

title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
description: More mouthwatering dishes from Andi Oliver, Niklas Ekstedt, Sabrina Ghayour and Rick Stein. Meanwhile, Rick Stein and Clive Myrie head out across the UK and abroad.

title: Best Bakes Ever
description: Jane Asher presents a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs.

title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
description: Nigel Slater creates simple but delicious meals from ingredients that are often overlooked, including a lentil and chard stew.

title: Jane Eyre
description: Based on Charlotte Bronte's classic novel about an orphan girl who grows up to become a governess in a gloomy manor in Yorkshire, where she falls in love with Mr Rochester.

description: Hitchcock thriller. A psychoanalyst falls in love with her new boss, knowing that he is an amnesiac who may also be a killer. Features dream sequences designed by Salvador Dali.

title: Flog It!
description: This episode contains a collection of interesting finds from the show's travels round the country, visiting Margam Country Park, Highcliffe Castle and Powderham Castle.

description: Final day highlights as the DP World Tour season reaches its climax. The winner of the Race to Dubai is crowned, with Northern Ireland's Rory McIlroy having won the last four editions.

title: Celebrity Race Across the World
description: The third leg of the race sees the teams leave behind the jungles of Borneo to reach the island of Sulawesi, an Indonesian wonderland that lies far from the tourist trail.

title: This Farming Life
description: Jenni moves her alpacas to their new arena. The MacDonalds organise a massive breakfast run for their pregnant cows. Nikki and Ollie invest in a new honesty shack.

title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
description: How one of the greatest French arts is that of patisserie.

description: Simon Reeve travels around the island of Ireland, beginning his journey in the south of Ireland, paramotoring with an Irish explorer. On the west coast, he does a spot of surfing.

title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
description: Paul and Bob visit the upper Tees in search of a very special wild brown trout.

title: A Course Called Ireland
description: Comedian Joanne McNally joins Bill for golf and oysters as his 75th birthday approaches. Contains some strong language.

title: Fontaines D.C. at Later... with Jools Holland
description: Jools Holland introduces a special edition of the show starring one of the biggest bands in the world, Fontaines D.C. Contains some strong language.

title: Rewarding
description: Francis tries desperately to keep new boss Sinead from quitting on her first day as the team tackle client Cal's birthday and a surprise inspection from Nicola. Contains adult humour.

title: Sunday Politics
description: Naomi Long joins Mark Carruthers to talk about the future of Stormont and Alliance polling. Plus, how should AI be regulated.
